description: This file declares auxiliary functions, macros, and constants used for debugging within the Lua interpreter. It provides interfaces for obtaining function info, error handling, and trace execution during debugging sessions.

methods.name: luaG_getfuncline
methods.description: Retrieves the line number associated with a given program counter within a function prototype.

methods.name: luaG_findlocal
methods.description: Finds the local variable at a specified index in a given call frame.

methods.name: luaG_typeerror
methods.description: Handles a type error in the Lua virtual machine.

methods.name: luaG_callerror
methods.description: Reports and handles an error occurring during function call.

methods.name: luaG_forerror
methods.description: Handles errors related to the 'for' loop constructs.

methods.name: luaG_concaterror
methods.description: Handles errors that occur during string concatenation.

methods.name: luaG_opinterror
methods.description: Handles operator errors between two values.

methods.name: luaG_tointerror
methods.description: Handles errors related to type conversions.

methods.name: luaG_ordererror
methods.description: Handles errors related to comparison operations.

methods.name: luaG_runerror
methods.description: Reports runtime errors with formatted messages.

methods.name: luaG_addinfo
methods.description: Adds additional info to an error message, indicating source and line number.

methods.name: luaG_errormsg
methods.description: Handles error messages in the Lua VM.

methods.name: luaG_traceexec
methods.description: Executes trace-based debugging at the program counter.

methods.name: luaG_tracecall
methods.description: Tracks function call traces during debugging.
